published.citation: von Essen et al. 2015, dayside brightness temperature at 1.05 µm (NASA Exoplanet Archive emission table): 3398 +/- 302 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...584A..75V/abstract

temperature.note: Its day side's brightness temperature is measured in secondary eclipse at 1.05 µm (LBT Consortium Large Binocular Telescope (LBT) at Mount Graham International Observatory Large Binocular Camera) and nobody has imaged it, so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
temperature.chosen: 1 measured of 111 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
temperature.facility: LBT Consortium Large Binocular Telescope (LBT) at Mount Graham International Observatory Large Binocular Camera
